headline: Events Sales Executive
summary: Events sales executive with five years selling and coordinating weddings, conferences and team-building events at a beach resort in Davao Oriental. I find and win event clients, negotiate packages and contracts, and then coordinate the event with our operations team so clients get what we promised.

experience.title: Events Sales Executive
experience.employer: Mati Bay Beach Resort and Convention Center
experience.paragraph: Responsible for event sales and client management for a resort with three function halls and a beachfront venue.
bullets: Find leads from companies, schools and wedding planners, and bring in about ₱24 million in event sales a year.
Negotiate packages, rates and contracts with clients.
Handle event and room bookings for groups and keep the events calendar.
Coordinate each event with operations and look after clients on the day.

experience.title: Guest Relations and Sales Associate
experience.paragraph: Split between guest relations and small-group sales.
bullets: Welcomed VIP guests and handled their requests during their stay.
Sold group packages to companies and kept client records.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
